notes: Lightning Memory-Mapped Database, in-process, single writer / many MVCC readers. No query engine: an ordered key-value map. The lab models documents plus hand-maintained ordered index keyspaces (idx/...); aggregations, text, geo and vector scan the primary keyspace. 8 GB map. No server, no network, no replication.
